verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents a built-in, configurable rate limiter meant to prevent abuse, with a stricter default rule on `/sign-in/email` (3 requests per 10 seconds). This directly addresses brute-force attempts on the login flow, and a community user confirms rate limiting comes built in. The pack shows nothing specific to bots or credential stuffing beyond generic rate limiting. missing for 10: bot/CAPTCHA protection, credential-stuffing defenses (e.g. breached-password checks, account lockout), independent hands-on validation of the rate limiter's effectiveness.
